-------

[Ingredients] (2 serves)

[Curry]
Water 570ml
Kombu 2g
Neutral oil about 1tbsp (15ml)
Frozen onion 250g
Garlic 1tsp (8g)
Salt 2 pinches
Black pepper

Japanese curry roux 46g
Worcestershire sauce 1/2tsp (2.5ml)
Milk 1tbsp (15ml)

---------

[Katsu]
Chicken thigh 400-430g
Salt 5g
Sugar 4g
Egg 1
All purpose flour 1.5tbsp (15g)
Toban Djan 1/4tsp (2g)

Dry panko 110g
Neural oil 55g

----------
